answer: To keep a cheap swarm from dominating grades, require every voting identity to sit at one graph vertex and lock a marble of coin there as slashable collateral. Admission is not a free mint: a newcomer may attach only as a lateral shoot on an already-attested vine, and for several epochs both the parent and child marbles are jointly liable if the new vertex emits junk answers or conflicting attestations. Isolated vertices with no vine history never accrue grading weight, so spinning hundreds of empty wallets still costs real bonded stake and a sponsor willing to risk it.
